description: Find UK List of Waste (EWC) codes for a waste, skip or load from one to three material words such as “plasterboard”, “mixed rubble” or “contaminated soil”, from one or more codes, or from a code prefix. Search each material separately, not a sentence; match says how many words the result covers, and a weak match returns no waste. Returns official entries with hazardous and mirror status, partner codes, source lineage and any assessment needed. Use the returned entries as candidates: origin, process and composition still determine the classification. To start a note with chosen codes, pass them to start_document.

limit.description: Maximum matched waste groups and official entries to return; defaults to 5.

query.description: One to three material words, one or more EWC/LoW codes, or a code prefix; common spaced, hyphenated and unspaced formats are accepted.

name: ewc_search

limit.description: What the result does not establish.

source.description: ComplyOnSite page that shows the same answer.

summary.description: The answer in one to three plain sentences, the figure or code first.

title: Find UK waste codes
